nodes.description: BotProtected.owner: privileged address set in BCUG constructor, gates delegate() and list().
BotProtected.botProtection: external contract address invoked through a low-level call in checkBots.
BotProtected.uniPair: Uniswap pair address passed as argument to the bot protection call.
BCUG.balanceOf mapping: token balances mutated in transferFrom and list.
BCUG.allowance mapping: spending approvals mutated in transferFrom, approve and the constructor.
BCUG.totalSupply: constant-like supply initialised to 313636000000000000000000 and read in list().
BCUG.uniRouter: Uniswap V2 router used by list() to add liquidity.
BCUG.wETH: wrapped ETH address used to derive the pair in the constructor.
BotProtected constructor: stores the bot protection contract address.
checkBots modifier: performs an unchecked low-level call to botProtection before running the guarded function body.
BCUG constructor: sets owner, computes uniPair via pairFor and grants unlimited allowances.
transfer: payable wrapper that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom: guarded by checkBots, updates allowance and balances with unchecked 0.7 arithmetic.
approve: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any validation.
delegate: owner-only function that delegatecalls arbitrary bytes to an arbitrary address.
pairFor: pure CREATE2-style address derivation for the Uniswap pair.
list: owner-only function that redistributes balances, adds liquidity via uniRouter with a block.timestamp deadline.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization and allowance accounting.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used to build the Uniswap deadline in list().
Low-level botProtection.call(...) with ignored return data and require(notABot); arbitrary external code execution before the guarded body.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): executes arbitrary calldata from an arbitrary address in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked Solidity 0.7 arithmetic: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value.
block.timestamp + 600 used as the Uniswap addLiquidityETH deadline (timestamp dependency).
Parameter _botProtection of the BotProtected constructor.
Parameter _from of the checkBots modifier.
Parameter _to of the checkBots modifier.
Parameter _value of the checkBots modifier.
Parameter _botProtection of the BCUG constructor.
Parameter _to of transfer().
Parameter _value of transfer().
Parameter _from of transferFrom().
Parameter _to of transferFrom().
Parameter _value of transferFrom().
Parameter _spender of approve().
Parameter _value of approve().
Parameter a (target address) of delegate().
Parameter b (calldata) of delegate().
Parameter tokenA of pairFor().
Parameter tokenB of pairFor().
Local token0: sorted lower address in pairFor().
Local token1: sorted higher address in pairFor().
Local pair: derived pair address returned by pairFor().
Parameter _numList of list(): amount assigned to the contract balance and used for liquidity.
Parameter _tos of list(): recipient array.
Parameter _amounts of list(): amount array.
Local i: loop index over _tos/_amounts in list().

edges.reason: BotProtected constructor writes the untrusted bot protection address into storage.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is stored into botProtection.

uniPair is passed as an argument to the low-level bot protection call.

The checkBots modifier performs the low-level external call before executing the guarded body.
The external call to botProtection runs before the transferFrom state updates, allowing re-entry into state-changing functions.
checkBots guards transferFrom and requires the external check to succeed before the body runs.
BCUG constructor parameter _botProtection is forwarded to the BotProtected constructor.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives an unlimited allowance on the pair in the constructor.
wETH is used as tokenA when deriving the Uniswap pair.
The constructor calls pairFor to compute uniPair.
pairFor returns the derived pair address to the constructor.
The constructor assigns the derived pair to uniPair.
The constructor writes unlimited allowances into the allowance mapping.
transfer parameter _to reaches transferFrom.
transfer parameter _value reaches transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the _from address in transfer.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_from indexes the balanceOf and allowance mappings.
_to indexes the balanceOf mapping for the credit.
_value drives the allowance and balance deductions.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf entries are read and updated in transferFrom.
Solidity 0.7 unchecked subtraction/addition on allowance and balances can silently over/underflow.
_spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
_value is written verbatim to allowance in approve.
msg.sender is the owner key written in approve.
Parameter a is the target of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the calldata of the delegatecall.
msg.sender must equal owner for delegate to proceed; authorization depends on a stored privileged address.
delegate executes the arbitrary delegatecall.
delegatecall executes untrusted external code in the contract's storage context.
tokenA is compared and encoded in pairFor.
tokenB is compared and encoded in pairFor.
token0 participates in the pair address hash.
token1 participates in the pair address hash.
_numList sets the contract balance and the liquidity amount in list.
_tos provides the distribution recipients in list.
_amounts provides the distribution amounts written into balanceOf in list.
Loop index i iterates over _tos.
list requires msg.sender == owner, so authorization relies on the stored owner address.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 is evaluated with unchecked 0.7 arithmetic to set the owner balance.
block.timestamp is used to build the Uniswap deadline, making execution miner-dependent.
block.timestamp + 600 forms the timestamp-based deadline value.
The timestamp deadline is consumed by addLiquidityETH inside list.
list calls uniRouter.addLiquidityETH.
list writes balances for the contract, owner and every recipient.
The loop over recipients is controlled by the local index i in list.
